description: This Go source file defines HTTP handlers for managing environment variables stored in '.env' files for agents within a control plane system. It includes operations for retrieving, setting, patching, and deleting environment variables, with validation and backup mechanisms, and incorporates schema-based masking of secret variables.

classes.name: EnvHandler
classes.description: Handler struct providing methods to manage environment variables of agents via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: NewEnvHandler
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a new EnvHandler with required dependencies.

methods.name: GetEnvHandler
methods.description: HTTP GET handler to retrieve environment variables for a specified agent and package, with masking of secret fields based on schema.

methods.name: PutEnvHandler
methods.description: HTTP PUT handler to replace environment variables for an agent and package, validating inputs before writing.

methods.name: PatchEnvHandler
methods.description: HTTP PATCH handler to update/add environment variables, merging with existing ones, with validation.

methods.name: DeleteEnvVarHandler
methods.description: HTTP DELETE handler to remove a specific environment variable from the agent's .env file, with validation and backup.
